findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Handwashing Cleanser, Availability. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

There was not any soap or paper towels observed at the handwashing sink. The operator was able to provide paper towels at the sink, but did not have any soap. Ensure that there is always soap and paper towels to allow for proper handwashing at the handwashing sink. A follow up is scheduled on 2/24/2025 to ensure that the facility has obtained soap.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container.
findings.comment:
3-602.11(B)(1)-(4) and (6) Food Labels. (B) Label information shall include: (1) The common name of the FOOD, or absent a common name, an adequately descriptive identity statement; (2) If made from two or more ingredients, a list of ingredients and subingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, including a declaration of artificial colors, artificial flavors and chemical preservatives, if contained in the FOOD; (3) An accurate declaration of the net quantity of contents; (4) The name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor; and (6) Except as exempted in the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act § 403(q)(3) - (5), nutrition labeling as specified in 21 CFR 101 - Food Labeling and 9 CFR 317 Subpart B Nutrition Labeling. 

There are prepackaged cuts of meat, smoked fish parts, and frozen produce in the facility that are not labeled with the common name of the product or the cooking instructions. All food needs to be labeled with the common name of the product and all meat needs labeled with cooking instructions. Discussed placing a general cooking instructions label on the outside of the freezers. Discussed reaching out to supplier about labels for the cuts of meat. Ensure that produce that is placed into a bag to be froze has the common name of the product. A follow up is scheduled on 3/5/2025 to ensure that all of these items have been labeled.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.citation_text:
5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided. 

It is observed that the facility has removed their handwashing sink that was in the back storage room next to the fridge. This handwashing sink needs replaced to allow for handwashing. A follow up is scheduled for 2/19/2025 to ensure that this handwashing sink has been replaced.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
The back outside door is missing the bottom seal.  Discussed with PIC, who has the piece, but has not put it on.  Ensure this part is installed to protect rodent and pest entry.

6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent.

findings.title: Plumbing installed; proper backflow devices
findings.comment:
The back sink by the refrigerator is leaking underneath.  Discussed with PIC, remove wet cardboard and clean floor to prevent mold growth.  Ensure the sink is repaired or put out of use.

5-205.15: A PLUMBING SYSTEM shall be: (A) Repaired according to LAW; P and (B) Maintained in good repair.
